What automation cannot cover

  • Signing with the wallet backgrounded on a phone. kWallet is always awake, so it can never fail this — a green here would mean nothing. Needs a real device.
  • A deliberately slow approval (sit on it ~45s). Guards a timeout cap that was wrong once already.
  • HashPack's own session lifecycle — clearing connections by hand, extension vs mobile app.
  • Animation and timing judgement — whether the wiper/confetti lands at the right moment.
